why: Neither must_not item shows up. Item 1: the builder brief wraps `JSON.parse` in try/catch, but only so it can "throw a new error" with the path, line and column. It also says "Do NOT adopt the issue's suggested fix of catching the parse error and returning `{}` or the defaults." So it never tells the builder to catch and return a value. Item 2: verifier check 2 uses `grep -qF` to find `bad config:` and the exact path. Both are things the issue requires, not one exact output format. For line and column it accepts any wording, "e.g. `line 3 column 3`, `3:3`, or `line 3, column 3`". It doesn't FAIL a run because of wording or order. No other part of either brief breaks the must_not list.
